pages.title: Spikes
pages.text: $(bold)Necklace:$() wounds monsters that press close to you.$(br2)$(bold)Bangle / Ring:$() blasts nearby monsters back with a burst of damage, leaving barbs behind that slow them.$(br2)$(bold)Cooldown:$() 2.8s per cast.$(br2)$(bold)Held by:$() Engravable Prismarine.
